title: Glumbocraft
description: Unserious changes for an unserious experience for your world
body:
This is a unserious resource pack for the glumbocorp minecraft server (I thought i'd share this pack here on modrinth)

It changes some blocks and items to be glumbo themed, and some mobs are also changed

The records that are retextured are songs which belong to [AQUASINE ](https://youtube.com/@_aquasine?si=0JlVlwjrorz4h5ue) for his sound collective [GLUMBO SOUND TEAM](https://youtube.com/@glumbosoundteam?si=NU5s2MzMTrKdlQE4) check him out!

Hope you enjoy this chaos!
